_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Grafana egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Grafana
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Grafana is a dashboard and visualization platform for metrics, logs and traces from sources such as Prometheus and Loki. Sign in as admin with the password admin, then choose a new one.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Grafana: downloads the release for the chosen version from Grafana Labs
# and checks its checksum, then installs the plugins asked for. Your
# settings (conf/custom.ini, conf/provisioning) and the data folder (the
# database, plugins) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
download() {
    curl -fsSL -o "$2.part" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download failed ($1). Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$2.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.part" "$2"
}
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

want="${GRAFANA_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag grafana/grafana latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    version="${tag#v}"
else
    version="${want#v}"
fi
base="https://dl.grafana.com/oss/release/grafana-$version.linux-$arch.tar.gz"
code=$(curl -sSL -o $work/grafana.sha256 -w '%{http_code}' "$base.sha256") || fail "Grafana Labs can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 404 ] && fail "Grafana has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 12.3.0."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "Grafana Labs can't be reached right now (HTTP $code). Reinstall to try again."
sum=$(cut -d' ' -f1 $work/grafana.sha256)

if [ -f VERSION ] && [ "$(cat VERSION)" = "$version" ] && [ -x bin/grafana ]; then
    echo "Grafana $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Grafana $version"
    download "$base" $work/grafana.tar.gz "$sum"
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf $work/grafana.tar.gz -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    rm -f $work/grafana.tar.gz
    # Your settings carry over into the new conf folder.
    if [ -f conf/custom.ini ]; then cp -a conf/custom.ini .raptor-new/conf/; fi
    if [ -d conf/provisioning ]; then rm -rf .raptor-new/conf/provisioning; cp -a conf/provisioning .raptor-new/conf/; fi
    put_release .raptor-new data
fi

mkdir -p data/plugins
if [ ! -f conf/custom.ini ]; then
    cat > conf/custom.ini <<'EOF'
; Your Grafana settings: https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/
; They override conf/defaults.ini, which a reinstall replaces, so make changes here.
; The port is set from the server's own port each time it starts.
[server]
http_port = 3000

[paths]
data = data
logs = data/log
plugins = data/plugins
EOF
fi

if [ -n "${GRAFANA_PLUGINS:-}" ]; then
    for p in $(tr ',' ' ' <<<"$GRAFANA_PLUGINS"); do
        echo "Installing the plugin $p"
        ./bin/grafana cli --homepath /mnt/server --pluginsDir /mnt/server/data/plugins plugins install "$p" >/dev/null ||
            fail "The plugin $p couldn't be installed. Check its name in Grafana's plugin catalog, then reinstall."
    done
fi
echo "Installed Grafana $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Grafana version to install, such as 12.3.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Plugins
variables.description: Plugins to install, separated by commas, such as yesoreyeram-infinity-datasource. Reinstall to add them.

variables.name: Usage reports
variables.description: Send anonymous usage statistics to Grafana Labs (true or false); this overrides reporting_enabled in custom.ini.
